title: Blog Database
objective: Model publishing content and related authors, tags and comments using intentional relationships.
scenario: Model publishing content and related authors, tags and comments using intentional relationships. Use only synthetic data in a dedicated, disposable MongoDB training environment.

milestones.title: Design and plan
acceptance_criteria: Describe the data shape, identifiers, relationships and access patterns.
List supported deployment/runtime requirements and any feature limitations.

milestones.title: Build representative behavior
acceptance_criteria: Use synthetic seed data and reproducible queries/configuration.
Include expected results and meaningful edge cases.

milestones.title: Verify and document
acceptance_criteria: Test error, boundary or retry behavior appropriate to the project.
Document indexes, access control, operational risks and reset/recovery steps.

starter_material.notes: Starter is a scaffold, not a production-ready implementation. Add runnable setup, teardown, tests and a README before relying on it.

stretch_features: Add reproducible test fixtures and a negative test suite.
Record query/index rationale and representative execution evidence.
Add monitoring, failure recovery and deployment-specific notes where relevant.
acceptance_criteria: All files have clear assumptions and are reproducible in an isolated lab.
Synthetic data is deterministic and contains no real personal or confidential information.
Expected behavior, results and edge cases are documented.
Security, version and deployment restrictions are explicit.
test_plan: Create a fresh disposable environment or collection set.
Load deterministic fixtures and validate expected outputs.
Run at least one negative/boundary test and one retry/failure test where relevant.
Repeat from a clean setup; document cleanup and recovery.

rubric.criterion: Test coverage, edge cases and reproducibility

status_note: Draft project. Reference solution is protected and should be used by reviewers, not returned by public APIs.
review_method: Human review, filesystem validation and test evidence in a permitted disposable MongoDB environment.
